name: Owner config, the launcher's copy
purpose: the launcher's copy of the owner config (the app's files/run = /run/powos-app/owner.conf): the speech servers its dictation uses (POWOS_STT_URL, POWOS_VOICE_URL); none = on-device dictation only
installedBy: powos devices enroll / targets/android/rooted/rooted.sh deploy -> powos-deploy.sh
